verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents per-record API actions, such as applying an Action Plan or triggering an Automation for a single person, plus list-level search and filtering via smart lists. There is no documented bulk update, bulk delete, batch endpoint, or mass-edit capability that acts on many items at once. Filtered reads and per-person automations are adjacent features and do not count as bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
